args.lesson: Verdict CHANGE. Reusing the saved Stotles and Tussell extracts (from 2026-11-07) meant only 2 new useful fetches were needed. Observed: Find a Tender gives account holders free saved searches and email notifications. Stotles' free tier lists 3 AI bid/no-bid reports plus alerts. Our own free preview.html already runs the same checks as the CAD49 brief, so the paid offer had cannibalized itself before any demand test. Tracker prices are rendered by script and could not be observed. What failed: I first wrote 'alerts not found' based on a truncated grep window. I corrected it after printing the full passage. Read the full context before recording an absence. Next time: before releasing a free version of a paid hypothesis, check that the paid tier still delivers something distinct. Do not build further tender inventory or tooling for per-notice reconciliation. The only accessible experiment is a passive read of classified feedback through 2027-01-08.
